args.text: First look: a red popcorn machine in the middle with a ring around it - red arc on top-left, yellow arc on the left, pale blue/white the rest. A dark smoke puff above it. A little beige person stands on a red line top right (a customer at a counter?). Coins 0 at top. Bottom card: a bin/bucket icon, 30 coins, +10 -> +16 with an up arrow - looks like an upgrade I can't afford yet. Top buttons: back, sound, restart. I think I can tap the machine to pop popcorn; maybe the ring is a heat gauge and the yellow is the sweet spot, red = burning (that smoke!). Expect: tapping the machine makes popcorn and coins.

Tapping the machine gave +1 coin and a striped popcorn bag flew up toward the counter line. A grey needle flashed at 12 o'clock on the ring. Now the needle is gone. The blue arc has clockwise arrows. Maybe holding moves a needle around the ring and I should release in the yellow zone? Trying a hold.

Holding 2s: needle swept clockwise almost all the way round and stopped in the RED zone at ~10:30. Got +3, some brown/burnt kernels fell out. So holding = heating, needle goes blue -> yellow -> red. I bet releasing in YELLOW is the perfect pop. Bottom card has a yellow fill bar - maybe progress toward 30 coins. Trying a 1.5s hold to land in yellow.

Yes! Released in the yellow zone = +10 and golden popcorn burst out. Coins 14. The bottom card fills up as I earn, so +10 -> +16 must be the perfect-pop payout upgrade for 30 coins. That felt good - a timing game. Doing it again.

Bought the upgrade (30). The machine got bigger with a striped awning and bunting - nice visual reward. Popcorn scattered all over the floor. Next upgrade: 54 coins, +16 -> +26. Icon changed from a bin to a cart on wheels. The yellow zone seems a bit wider and there's a pale section at the top-right start of the ring. The customer on the red line top-right still hasn't moved - not sure what he's for. Continuing perfect pops.

Tapped the customer: it just counted as a quick tap anywhere (+1). So the whole screen is the press area. The customer and the striped bag on the red line don't seem to react. Maybe the line is a progress track toward him? The bag hasn't moved along it yet. Back to perfect pops; trying a slightly longer hold to see if deeper yellow pays more.

53 coins - one short of 54, ha. Payout seems flat anywhere in yellow (+16 both early and deep). A quick tap gives +1, so one tap will get me there. Mildly annoying to be 1 short but the +1 tap is a handy top-up.

Second upgrade bought at 1:56 - the stand became a popcorn CART on wheels, bigger and puffier popcorn. Next: 97 coins, +26 -> +40, the icon is now a bigger cart. Prices roughly double, payout ~1.6x, so each step is ~4 perfect pops. The loop is clear now. Wondering if the man on the counter ever matters.

78 coins, every 1.6s hold is landing in yellow for +26. Getting into a rhythm. It's calm and cozy but already a bit samey - hold, release, hold. Hoping the next tier (97) adds something new besides a bigger number.

Third upgrade at 2:37: big sparkle burst! A SECOND customer (green) appeared at the counter next to the beige one, and a new grey round knob with a red handle appeared on the right side of the cart - looks like a crank. Next: 175 coins, +40 -> +66, star on the cart icon. Exciting - something new! Going to try the crank: tap it first, then maybe drag in a circle.

Dragging the red handle turned the crank - it now points down - and I got +6. Not sure if the +6 came from the crank or because the drag also counted as a short hold on the heat ring. Going to keep cranking round (bottom -> left -> top) to see what turning it does.

Second crank drag: +5, and the ring needle stopped in the BLUE zone near 2 o'clock. I think my drags are really just short holds released early (blue = small payout), and the crank turning is cosmetic or I'm not doing it right. Let me just wait a few seconds hands-off to see if the crank or the two customers do anything on their own.

After waiting: no idle income, customers still frozen. The ring's blue part faded back to pale white like at the very start - maybe the ring cools down when I stop. Back to perfect pops for the 175 upgrade (+40 each).

139 coins, three +40 pops in a row. The crank handle spins round a bit on each pop now - so it's just animation, I think. Golden popcorn spray each perfect pop is satisfying. One more pop then buy at 175.

4:06 bought the 175 upgrade: bigger cart, and a NEW blue card appeared above: a gear, 260 coins, 'x1.3'. Main upgrade is now 430 for +66 -> +104. Also a little yellow STAR sits at 12 o'clock on top of the ring. Guess: gear = speed (needle or crank 1.3x faster?) or a multiplier on coins. Gear is cheaper so I'll go for it first. Not sure what the star means - a bonus spot?
Perfect pop now gives +66. The star at the top stays put. Popping more for the gear.

4:46 bought the gear: it was a x1.3 coin multiplier - the main card now reads +85 -> +135 instead of +66 -> +104. A little box with a dot appeared under the crank (a motor?). New blue card: a small cart, 1,200 coins, '+0 > +19  3.0s' - looks like an auto-popper that earns +19 every 3 seconds by itself. Pricey. Main upgrade still 430. I like that the gear's effect showed up immediately in the numbers.
+85 per pop now. Curious about that star at 12 o'clock, right at the end of the red zone. Risky experiment: hold long (~2.4s) to see if reaching the star does something special, or if it just burns.

Star experiment failed: needle stopped at ~11 o'clock in the red, brown burnt popcorn, only +24 instead of +85. So the star isn't reachable that way, or it's just a decoration / rank badge. Lesson learned, back to yellow.

287 coins. Two more perfect pops to 430. The striped bag sits on the red line right now - every pop sends a bag up there but the two customers never come take it. I keep wondering if I'm supposed to deliver it to them somehow.

5:56 bought the 430 upgrade - big change! Three jars appeared on the left: yellow x1.0 (selected, with a wide yellow arc under it), brown x1.5 (with only a tiny yellow tick under it) and orange x1.35 (an arc plus a little clock). I read it as kernel types: higher multiplier = smaller sweet spot, and the clock one has some time twist. Main upgrade now 1,050 (+135 -> +218), auto cart 1,200 now says +31 every 3s. Trying the brown x1.5 jar.

Brown x1.5 jar selected: the ring changed - blue now runs all the way to 9 o'clock, yellow moved to ~9-11 o'clock and the red is a short stub before the top. Main card now shows +202. So this kernel needs a LONGER hold. From earlier, 2s landed at ~10:30, so I'll try ~1.85s.

Nailed it: 1.85s with the brown jar landed at ~10:30 in the yellow, +202 (vs +135 with plain). Very satisfying to figure out the new timing just from the ring. Some kernels came out brown-ish but still full pay. Repeating.

Oops, last one overshot just past the yellow into the red stub: +101 (half), some brown/white scattered kernels. The brown jar's window is tight - that's the risk for x1.5. Pulling back to 1.8s. 431 coins now.

1.8s is the sweet hold for the brown jar. Building toward 1,050. Thinking about whether to buy the auto cart (1,200, +31 every 3s) - that's only ~10/s while my pops give 202 per ~5s, so the main upgrade looks better.
1,037 - again just 13 short of the 1,050 upgrade, ha. One more pop. Both cards are almost full now.

7:26 bought the 1,050 upgrade: sparkles, cart gets a gold stripe, and a THIRD customer (teal) joined the queue. So customers = a visual tally of my big upgrades. Next: 2,500 (+327 -> +522); auto cart now +50 every 3s. With ~2.5 minutes left I want to peek at the orange x1.35 clock jar to see what the clock means.

Orange x1.35 jar: the yellow zone is HUGE and early, from about 5 o'clock to 9 o'clock. Payout +294 vs +327 for brown. So the clock = quick pops: shorter hold, wide forgiving window, slightly less per pop. Trying a 1.3s hold.

Hmm: 1.3s stopped the needle at ~5:30, which LOOKS inside the yellow, but I only got +147 (half) and pale white kernels flew out - underdone? Confusing: either the start of the yellow doesn't count, or the clock means the window shifts. Trying 1.5s.

1.5s with orange: +294, needle at ~6:30 - deeper in the yellow. Interesting, the needle seems slower with this jar (1.5s used to reach 8 o'clock). Maybe that's the clock: slower heating, wide window. Rushing toward 2,500 before time runs out.
1,218 coins - the blue auto-cart card is lit up. It's weaker than popping, but I'm curious what it actually looks like, and it's new content, so I'm buying it with my last 1.5 minutes.

Bought it: a tiny second cart appeared on the right side with its own blue ring filling up like a timer - cute, a little helper. Next helper upgrade: 3,600 (+50 > +58, 3.0 > 2.7s). The big ring went all pale while I wasn't holding. Waiting a few seconds to watch the helper pay out.

Oh nice - the helper cart's bag actually flies all the way to the customers on the counter (the teal one) and pays +50 there. That's the first time the customers 'do' anything! Coins 18 -> 268 while I just watched. The idle income feels great. Back to popping in my last minute.
Combined: my pops (+294) plus the helper ticking +50 in the background. Coins climbing fast now, 762 at 9:02. Might just reach 2,500 before the end.

9:41 bought the 2,500 upgrade (first tap at 9:34 seemed not to register, needed a second tap). Now the machine has TWO kettles inside! Helper now +80, next main upgrade 5,800 (+470 -> +754). Final pop before time runs out.
